name: xmarks
description: Claude Code plugins by arazvan. Includes flywheel: a spec→plan→work→verify→review→compound loop for disciplined AI-assisted development, plus an agent-native runtime pillar (/flywheel:process + /flywheel:run) where Claude executes and matures recurring domain operations that persist to the repo's own datastore.

plugins.name: flywheel
plugins.description: Nested spec→plan→work→verify→review→compound loop for disciplined AI-assisted development, plus an agent-native runtime pillar (/flywheel:process + /flywheel:run) that turns recurring domain operations into self-improving, persistence-aware process contracts Claude executes as the backend. Also an autonomous metric-driven loop, parallel multi-specialist review, and spec↔code sync. Plans route each task to a model/effort tier so cheap work runs cheap and judgment runs strong. /flywheel:route does the same for work delegated outside a plan: tool, fresh session or subagent, at which model and effort.

plugins.name: resource-committee
plugins.description: Mod: assigns each turn its model and effort (sonnet/medium default, opus/high for judgment, sonnet/low for mechanical), decided once per prompt so the cache survives.

plugins.name: big-brother-token
plugins.description: Mod: the Ministry watches every byte — live bytes read, cost and context in the status line; toasts for oversized reads and full rewrites; /ministry dossier.

plugins.name: memory-hole
plugins.description: Mod: a list you were handed is a file, not a memory — a prompt with a list holds edits until it is written to a plan or scratchpad file.

plugins.name: ventanilla-unica
plugins.description: Mod: the single window — /ventanilla runs flywheel's sweep and stamps each gate as it clears; a missing stamp sends you back tomorrow.

plugins.name: social-credit
plugins.description: Mod: every act is scored — edits over rewrites, tests first, no silent skips; below 80 the system prompt re-educates you.

plugins.name: thought-police
plugins.description: Mod: never echo a file into chat — a reply that pastes back code just written is stopped once and sent back to say what and where.

plugins.name: newspeak
plugins.description: Mod: ungood items — a list item with no success criterion is named, and the model is told to ask for one before doing it.

plugins.name: ration-book
plugins.description: Mod: every session gets a ration of read bytes, set from its own history; when the coupons run out, reads wait for an authorized grant.

plugins.name: black-market
plugins.description: Mod: every exception is contraband — SKIP_*/--no-verify/Release-Exception use is ledgered with its reason, and /black-market audit totals the standing permits.
